changes.spells: Reject disappeared explicit targets at authority, during approach and during paid windup/save restoration instead of falling back to the caster location. Freed Object references are distinguished from intentional null point targets by TYPE_OBJECT, because Godot compares freed objects equal to null.
changes.shadows: Exclude shadow passes from reflection-camera clipping; include terrain in sun casters while keeping decal and offscreen-unit exclusions.

shadow_cause.source: Godot 4.7 RenderSceneDataRD.camera_visible_layers is uninitialized in RenderForwardClustered::_render_shadow_append, then copied into the scene UBO.
shadow_cause.effect: The old reflection clipping shader could read the arbitrary marker bit during a shadow pass and discard geometry below the last reflection water level. This reproduces detached head shadows and missing fence rails; a change in that bit restores them.
shadow_cause.fix: Gate both reflection-only discard paths with !IN_SHADOW_PASS. No engine or native-library changes.
shadow_cause.deterministic_replay: Inject the undefined marker only in the shadow pass. Compare actual humanoid, first-person shadow proxies and fence-shaped scenery using production shaders against an independent no-clip reference at two camera positions.
shadow_cause.before: Old shadow shader failed all six complete-shadow comparisons; head-only and partial-fence silhouettes captured.
shadow_cause.after: Fixed shader equals reference pixels in all six cases; removing the guard reproduces 116-316 changed pixels at 320x240; clearing the arbitrary marker restores the reference.
shadow_cause.lifecycle: Original Ingos lake reflection, then bz8k -> bz1g -> bz8k, twelve camera/preview cycles and repeated first-person movement; 23 assertions pass.

original_executable_reference.melee: 0x54ca40, 0x54c070 and 0x54c2f0 use planar reach and obstruction tests without flying-target immunity. Melee may hit a dragon within reach; gameplay unchanged.
original_executable_reference.preview: 0x648290 reads info_scale and altitude for unit preview framing. Existing native draw reconstruction documents the clipped 1/info_scale presentation; the remake full-bounds fit was removed.
